title: Climbing the Rating Ladder: Up to 1000
summary: Chess player John Bartholomew plays opponents rated below 1000 on Chess.com and comments on optimal strategy and typical mistakes at that level. It is part of his Climbing the Rating Ladder series.
why: Strongly recommended as a way to improve at chess, since it explains the basics and common mistakes at each rating level.

quote.text: He explains the basics and mistakes players at each level makes and how to avoid them
